narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced localized flash flooding in Stannard, VT on the afternoon of June 17, 2023.
ev: Trained spotter relayed localized flash flood damage via pictures in the town of Stannard, VT along Stannard Mountain Road. A culvert washout and damage to a bridge was noted at 44.55, -72.24 and included in a Local Storm Report. Estimates of 1.5 to 2.5 inches of rainfall occurred in this area, which lies in steep, mountainous terrain.
lsr: Damage to bridge and partial washout on Stannard Mountain Road. Delayed report.
